reviews.title: Better now.
reviews.comment: So, I've never ever had an issue with corsair Ram sticks until this year when I have upgraded. There's no way it's a Cpu or Gpu issue at this point as I've done everything I can think of for both. And the only conclusion I can come u o with is.. the ram just sucks. I can barely play any of my games everything stutters so hard that I can barely play an fps title let alone anything else. Gpu is not the issue as I've tested and benchmarks both cpu and gpu and there's no issues. EDIT: It was a bad motherboard. It runs like a dream.
